(c) the number of youth wellness centres operational under the National Youth Policy or in  
collaboration with the Ministry of Health;
(d) whether any partnership has been made with civil society or digital platforms for youth  
counselling; and
(e) the new preventive and awareness initiatives launched since 2023 for youth wellbeing?
ANSWER
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA)
(a) As a part of World Mental Health Day 2024 observance, Rajiv Gandhi National Institute of  
Youth  Development  (RGNIYD)  under  Department  of  Youth  Affairs  has  organised  two  
programmes: 
I. Half day workshop on and self-hypnosis and 
II. Psychology exhibition.
(b) No such study has been conducted by the Ministry of youth Affairs &Sports to assess the  
incidence of depression, anxiety, or substance abuse among youth aged 15-29.
407                                                      

(c) There is no specific youth wellness centre operational under National Youth Policy , the  
mental Health care Act, 2017 is an act to provide  for mental healthcare and services for persons  
with mental illness and to protect, promote, and fulfil the rights of  such persons during delivery  
of mental  healthcare  and services and for matter  connected  therewith  or incidental  thereto.  
However, to address the burden of mental disorders, the Government of India is implementing  
the National Mental Health Programme (NMHP) in the country. The District Mental Health  
Programme (DMHP) component of the NMHP has been sanctioned for implementation in 767  
districts  for  which  support  is  provided  to  States/UTs  through  the  National  Health  Mission. 
Facilities made available under DMHP at the Community Health Centre (CHC) and Primary  
Health  Centre  (PHC)  levels,  inter-alia,  include  outpatient  services,  assessment,  counselling/  
psycho-social interventions, continuing care and support to persons with severe mental disorders, 
drugs,  outreach  services,  ambulance  services  etc.  In  addition  to  above  services  there  is  a  
provision of 10 bedded in-patient facility at the District level. The objectives of DMHP are:
(i)  to  provide  suicide  prevention  services,  work place  stress  management,  life  skills  
training and counselling in schools and colleges.
(ii) to provide mental  health  services including prevention, promotion and long-term  
continuing care at different levels of district healthcare delivery system.
(ii) to augment institutional capacity in terms of infrastructure, equipment and human  
resource for mental healthcare.
(iv)  to  promote  community  awareness  and  participation  in  the  delivery  of  mental  
healthcare services.
In addition to the above, the Government is also taking steps to strengthen mental healthcare  
services at primary healthcare level. The Government has upgraded more than 1.77 lakh Sub  
Health  Centres  SHCs)  and  Primary  Health  Centres  (PHCs)  to  Ayushman  Arogya  Mandirs. 
Mental  health  services  have  been  added  in  the  packages  of  services  under  Comprehensive 
Primary Health Care provided at these Ayushman Arogya Mandirs. Operational guidelines and  
training manuals form various cadres on Mental, Neurological, and Substance Use Disorders  
(MNS) at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs have been released under the ambit of Ayushman Bharat.
Under  the  tertiary  care  component  of  National  Mental  Health  Programme  (NMHP),  under  
Manpower Development Scheme-A, 25 Centres of Excellence (CoE) have been sanctioned to  
increase the intake of students in PG departments in mental health specialities as well as to  
provide  tertiary  level  treatment  facilities.  Further,  the  Government  has  also  supported  19  
Government medical colleges/institutions to strengthen 47 PG Departments in mental health  
specialties under Manpower Development Scheme-B.
There are 47 Government run mental hospitals in the country, including 3 Central Mental Health  
Institutions, viz. National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences, Bengaluru, Lokopriya  
Gopinath Bordoloi Regional Institute of Mental Health, Tezpur, Assam and Central Institute of  
Psychiatry, Ranchi. Mental Health Services are also provisioned in all AIIMS.
408                                                      

(d) The Government has launched a “National Tele Mental Health Programme” on 10th  
October, 2022, to further improve access to quality mental health counselling and care services  
in the country. As on 12.03.2025, 36 States/UTs have set up 53 Tele MANAS Cells and have  
started tele mental health services. More than 23,82,000 calls have been handled on the helpline  
number. The Government has also launched Tele MANAS Mobile Application  on the  
occasion of World Mental Health Day - October 10, 2024. Tele-MANAS Mobile Application is  
a comprehensive mobile platform that has been developed to provide support for mental health  
issues ranging from well-being to mental disorders.
(e) The Government has also formulated our country’s first National Suicide Prevention  
Strategy.  The  Strategy  is available  on the website  of Ministry of Health  & family  welfare  
(Link:https://main.mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/National%20Suicide%20Prevention%2 
Strategy.pdf).
Further, the Department of Youth Affairs through MY Bharat recognized the detrimental impact  
of drug addiction and substance abuse on individuals and families and conducted Awareness and  
Education Programme on Drug-addiction and Substance Abuse across the country, during the  
FY-2024-25.The aim of the programme is to:
(i) Increase  awareness by  educating  youth  about  the  harmful  effects  of  drug  use,  
including physical, psychological and social consequences, 
(ii) Promoting healthy alternatives  by encouraging engagement in positive activities  
like sports , arts, cultural events and community service, 
(iii) Develop life skills  by enhancing communication, decision making, problem-solving  
and Break down stigma and coping skills to resist peer pressure and build resilience, 
(iv) Break down stigma  by promoting understanding and empathy towards individuals  
struggling with drug addiction and substance abuse, encouraging them to seek help  
and 
(v) Strengthen community action  by fostering collaboration with local stakeholders to  
create a drug-free environment and offer support services.

2232.  Shri Ashokrao Shankarrao Chavan : 
  
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government has organized a 'Youth Spiritual Summit' in Varanasi recently 
and if so, details thereof;  
(b) the aims and objectives of said Summit;  
(c) the number of youth delegates participated in said Summit and crit eria adopted for their 
selection;  
(d) whether substance abuse remains the gravest threats confronting our youth posing a 
challenge to national progress;  
(e) if so, specific sessions and activities planned during summit to address and ensure 
implementation of the strategies discussed during the summit on the issue of drug 
addiction; and  
(f) the details of any follow -up actions or programmes planned post -summit to sustain the 
momentum against drug addiction ? 
  
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS 
  
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
  
(a) & (b) Yes, the Government recently organized a Three -day 'Youth Spiritual Summit' in 
Varanasi from 18th to 20th July 2025. The Summit, themed "Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit 
Bharat", brought together delegates from the youth wings  of more than 120 spiritual 
organisations and various domain experts, Ministries and other organizations to develop a 
comprehensive, youth -led national strategy for a drug -free India. The deliberations 
culminated in the release of the Kashi Sankalp, a cons ensus-based action agenda towards 
Nasha Mukt Bharat. 
 
(c)  Approximately 600 youth delegates participated in the Summit, representing youth wings 
of various spiritual organisations from across the country.  Delegates were typically in the 
419                                                      

age group of 25 –40 years. The Ministry consulted organisations affiliated with the Ministry 
of Culture and other relevant bodies. Based on their interest and willingness to participate, 
formal invitations were extended to spiritual organisations from across India 
 
(d) & (e) Yes, the Government is fully aware that substance abuse constitutes one of the most 
serious threats to the well -being and potential of Indian youth, and consequently, to the 
country’s development trajectory.   List of thematic sessions and activities rel ated to drug 
addiction, conducted during the event are as follows: 
Session 1: Understanding Addiction: Nature, Types, Demographics of Youth Addict 
Victims 
Session 2: Decoding the Nexus: Peddler Networks, Access, International Influence 
Session 3: Effective Campaigning and Outreach 
Session 4: Vision 2047 – Roadmap and Commitment & signing of the Kashi Sankalp 
Public Program: A Nukkad Natak highlighting the effects of drug use and a theme 
based cultural performance by a team from Ministry of Culture was also staged.  This 
event was attended by eminent personalities from the region and also local youth.

Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Home Affairs and som e present as well as 
past Members of Parliament active in the field of drug de -addiction and other experts in the 
field. 
 
(f) The Kashi Sankalp adopted during the Youth Spiritual Summit in Varanasi outlines a 
collaborative approach to tackling substance ab use through youth -led public campaigns, 
institutional outreach, and multi -stakeholder coordination. It emphasizes the cultural and 
constitutional imperative of a drug -free society. The declaration details roles for spiritual 
bodies, educational institutions, and Government ministries in prevention, rehabilitation, and 
awareness. It also includes mechanisms for Joint Working Groups, public reporting, and 
structured action planning.

FUNCTIONING OF NSS IN THE COUNTRY 
  
2234 SHRI S. SELVAGANABATHY: 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
  
(a) the number of students in the country enrolled in National Service Scheme ason date; 
  
(b) whether Government is insisting all the secondary school, colleges and universities level 
students to join NSS; 
  
(c) if so, the action taken by Government for not participating in the NSS; and 
  
(d) the number of States/UTs that have been benefitted under the National Service 
Scheme award so far and the details thereof? 
  
ANSWER 
  
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
  
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
  
(a): The enrolment of Volunteers in National Service Scheme (NSS) as on 
31.03.2025 is 38,74,124. 
(b): No. NSS is a voluntary service scheme therefore the Government encourages the students 
of secondary school, colleges and universities to join NSS as volunteers. 
(c): Does not arise.  
(d): So far, 28 states (All states of Union of India) and 5 UTs (Chandigarh, Dadra and Nagar 
Haveli and Daman and Diu, Delhi, Jammu & Kashmir and Puducherry) have been benefitted 
under the National Service Scheme award. The details of these are available at the following  
link:  
https://nss.gov.in/sites/default/files/NSS%20Awardee%20list%201993-2021.pdf

CERTIFICATION AND TRAINING OF ADVENTURE SPORTS 
 
2235. Shri Vivek K. Tankha: 
 
Will the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether there exists a national certification system for adventure sports instructors and  
operators in the country; 
(b) if so, the number of certified instructors across various ad venture sports available in the 
country; 
(c) whether any training institutes have been established for adventure sports; and 
(d) the steps taken to ensure quality training and skill development in this sector? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
 
(SHRI MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (d):  Several institutes such as Himalayan Mountaineer ing Institute (HMI), Darjeeling , 
National Institute of Water Sports (NIWS), Goa, Jawahar Institute of Mountaineering & Winter 
Sports (JIM&WS), J&K, National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS), 
Dirang, Arunachal Pradesh are providing  training in adventure sports. These institutes offer 
various training programmes for adventure sports in line with modern techniques, adherence to 
safety protocols and use of contemporary training equipment and technology.

DEVELOPMENT OF SPORTS INFRASTRUCTURE IN MAHARASHTRA 
 
2236 SHRI DHANANJAY BHIMRAO MAHADIK: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state :- 
  
(a) the current status of sports infrastructure projects in Maharashtra, including stadiums, training 
centres, and sports complexes; 
 
(b) the funds allocated and utilized for these developments in the last three years; 
 
(c) the measures taken to ensure accessibility for rural and urban youth; and 
 
(d) the plans to upgrade existing facilities to international standards? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (d) ‘Sports’ being a State subject, the responsibility of development of sports, including 
allocating and utilizing funds for development of sports infrastructure  such as stadiums, training 
centres, and sports complexes, ensuring accessibility of such sports facilities to both rural and urban 
youth and upgrade the existing sports infrastructure in the State to meet international standards , 
rests primarily with the respective State/Union Territory Governments. The Union Government 
only supplements their efforts by bridging critical gaps. The details of various sports infrastructure 
across the country, which are under the jurisdiction of respective State/Union Territory 
Governments, are not maintained in this Ministry. The details of the sports infrastructure projects 
approved and their sanctioned cost, funds released and their physical and financial progress, under 
Khelo India Scheme and National Sports Development Fund (NSDF), across the country, including 
in the State of Maharashtra, are available in public domain on the dashboards of the Ministry at 
https://mdsd.kheloindia.gov.in and http://www.nsdf.yas.gov.in/nsdf -glance.html. The details of 
Sports Authority of India (SAI) Training Centres (STCs) across the country are available at 
https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/sai_new/sai-training-center. 
 
Funds are allocated and released Scheme -wise and not State-wise in this Ministry . The details of 
funds allocated and expenditure incurred under various Sports Development Schemes of the 
Department of Sports across the country, including for development of stadiums, training centres 
and sports complexes, during the last three years are as under:

The sports facilities supported under these schemes are available to all citizens of the country, 
including rural and urban youth. 
 
The Khelo India Scheme and National Sports Development Fund (NSDF), implemented by this 
Ministry, under which financial assistance for development of sports infrastructure is provided, are 
demand-driven schemes. The proposals received from the State/UT Governments and other eligible 
entities are considered for financial support, subject to their completeness, technical feasibility and 
availability of funds under the Scheme. No specific plan for upgradation has been formulated by the 
Ministry for the State; assistance is extended as per the provisions of these schemes based on 
proposals received.

2240  Shri Ajit Kumar Bhuyan: 
 
Will the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether it is a fact that there are many sportspersons coming from North Eastern Region 
for many international competitions without proper amenities; 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
(c) whethe r any initiatives have been taken to enhance the financial security, training 
infrastructure and mental wellness support for the Sportspersons; 
(d) if so, the details thereof; and 
(e) the steps taken by Government to ensure the timely disbursal of financia l assistance and 
incentives to sportspersons under various schemes? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS  
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) & (b) : No, Sir. Requisite amenities for sportspersons are provisioned under various 
schemes/programs of this Ministry . Details of training facilities in North Eastern Region are 
given at Annexure-I.  
 
(c) & (d): “Sports” being a State subject the responsibility for promotion and development of 
sports, including enhancing financial security, training infrastructure and mental wellness 
support for the sportspersons, rests primarily with the respective State Government. However, 
the Central Government supplements their efforts through its various 
schemes/programs/initiatives, as under: 
• Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS): Provides comprehensive support to selected 
sportspersons including monthly Out -of-Pocket Allowance (OPA),  access to 
international training, coaching, physiotherapy, mental conditioning, and equipment. 
449                                                      

• Khelo India Scheme: Focuses on talent identification, infrastructure development, athlete 
scholarships, and coaching support at both grassroots and elite levels. 
• Assistance to National Sports Federations (ANSF): Financial support is provided towards 
training of athletes which includes all requisite facilities for their preparations including 
wholesome nutritious diet, food supplements, equipment support, state -of-the-art 
infrastructure, lodging, travelling facilities, services of reputed Coaches/supporting staff, 
scientific & medical support, sports kit, etc. besides financial assistance for their training 
abroad and participation in international competitions in India and abroad. 
• Scheme of Sports Fund for Pension to Meritorious Sportspersons provides additional 
financial security to sportspersons post retirement from active sports career in the form 
of life-time pension ranging from ₹12,000/- to ₹20,000/- per month. The sportspersons, 
who are retired from an active sports career and won medals in Olympic Games, 
Paralympic Games, World Cup, World Championships, Asian Games, Para Asian Games 
and Commonwealth Games, are eligible for life-time pension under the scheme. 
• Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Program for Sportspersons provides 
financial assistance, ranging from ₹2 lakhs to ₹10 lakhs, to sportspersons and their 
families for injury, hardship, equipment, and event participation, etc. 
The details of aforementioned schemes/programmes are available on this Ministry’s website at 
https://yas.nic.in/  
Further, to provide mental wellness support to sportspersons, sport psychologists and mental 
trainers are engaged at both national team and individual levels. Presence of a sports 
psychologist, including High -Performance Analyst (Psychology) or Performance Analyst 
(Psychology) is ensured at the National Centres of Excellence (NCoE) of SAI. These sports 
psychologists are respo nsible for helping the athletes with the mental training pertaining to 
optimal performance, as well as enabling them to achieve emotional wellbeing also. 
Besides, the Government has recently announced Khelo Bharat Niti -2025 which also, inter -
alia, has prov isions to address the challenges being faced by the sportspersons and the 
coaches/trainers. 
 
(e) The Government has adopted a series of measures to ensure the timely and transparent 
disbursal of financial assistance and incentives to sportspersons/coaches under various 
schemes. Key measures among these is the implementation of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) 
mechanism for disbursement and online portals to digitize the  process of inviting applications, 
thus ensuring the timely and efficient disbursement of f inancial assistance/incentives to 
beneficiaries. Under this system, financial assistance/support is directly transferred into the 
bank accounts of the sportspersons/coaches thereby eliminating delays, reduces administrative 
bottlenecks, and ensures that th e benefits reach the intended beneficiaries in a timely and 
efficient manner.

एक ीक ृत/मैप की  गई योजनाओं  के  भलए वन -स्र्ॉप सॉलयूिन  प्रदान करता  है, लेककन  यह ननयंत्रक के  रूप  में काम  नहीं  
करता।  पात्र लािाथी इन  योजनाओं  के  तहत लाि उठा सकते  हैं भले ही वे ई -श्रम पोर्टल पर पंज ीक ृत हो या न  हो।   
 
अब तक ,  ई-श्रम क ाड टध ारक ों क ो लाभ पहुंचान े और सामाजज क  सुरक्षा, ब ीमा अथवा  कौिल ववकास कायटक्रमों 
तक  पहुंच प्रदान  क रन े के शलए वव शभन्न  केंद्रीय मंत्रालयों/वव भागों क ी चौदह (14) योजनाओं को पहले ही ई -श्रम के साथ 
एक ीक ृत/मैप कक या ज ा चुक ा है जजसमें प्रधानमंत्री स्रीर् वेंडसट आत्मननभटर ननधध (पीएमस्वननधध) , प्रध ान मंत्री सुरक्षा ब ीमा 
योजना (पीएमएसबीवाई) , प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योनत बीमा योजना (पीएमजेजेबीवाई) , राष्रीय पाररवाररक लाभ योजना 
(एनएफबीएस) , महात्मा गांधी राष्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंर्ी योजना  (एमजीएनआरईजीएस), प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना 
- ग्रामीण (पीएमएवाई-जी) , आयुष्मान  भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (एबी-पीएमजेएवाई) , प्रधानमंत्री आवास 
योजना - िहरी (पीएमएवाई -यू), प्रधानमंत्री मत्स्य सम्पदा योजना (पीएमएमएसवाई), प्रधानमंत्री ककसान मान धन 
योजना (पीएम -केएमवाई) , व न  न ेिन  व न  रािन  क ाड ट (ओएन ओआरसी) और प्रध ान मंत्री मातृ व ंदन ा योज न ा 
(पीएमएमवी वाई) िाशमल हैं।  
उपयुटक्त योज न ाओं के अलाव ा, ई-श्रम को प्रधानमंत्री श्रम योगी मान-धन (पीएम -एसवाईएम) , राष्रीय कररयर 
सेवा (एनसीएस) , जस्कल इंडडया डडजजर्ल हब (शसद्ध), न ए युग के िासन  के शलए एक ीक ृत मोब ाइल एजप्लकेिन  (उमंग), 
डडजजर्ल लॉकर (डडजजलॉकर) , माईस्कीम और ओपन  गव न टमेंर् डेर्ा प्लेर्फॉमट (ओज ीडी) के साथ भी एक ीक ृत कक या गया

पि संख्या 1122 क े  मुकाबले में ,  788 न्यायािीश कायतरत हैं और न्यायािीशों क े  334 पि

उच्च न्यायालयों में न्यायािीशों की धनयुवक्त भारत क े  संवििान क े  अनुच्छेि 217 और 
224 क े अिीन और उच्चतम न्यायालय क े  ताऱीख  6 अक्तूबर, 1993 क े  धनणतय (कद्वतीय

न्यायािीशों से परामशत करक े, उच्च न्यायालयों में न्यायािीशों की धनयुवक्त क े  धलए प्रस्तािों क े  
आरंभ ककए िाने का उत्तरिाधयत्ि संबंधित उच्च न्यायालय क े  मुख्य न्यायामूधतत में धनकहत 
होता है। एमओपी क े  अनुसार, उच्च न्यायालयों से अपेक्षा की िाती है कक िे ककसी ररवक्त क े

विरलतया पालन ककया िाता है । उच्च न्यायालयों में धनयुवक्तयों क े  धलए , संबंधित राज्य 
सरकार क े  अधभमत एमओपी क े  अनुसार प्राप्त ककए िाते हैं । इन धसफाररशों पर ऐसी अन्य 
ररपोर्टों क े  आलोक में भी विचार ककया िाना होता है िो विचारािीन नामों क े  संबंि में सरकार

।

न्यायािीशों क े  रूप में धनयुक्त ककया िाता है । मई, 2014 से 4.8.2025 तक , 1099 न्यायािीशों

त्रुकटयों की पहचान हेतु ई-फाइधलंग सॉफ्टिेयर में एकीकृत एआई (कृवत्रम बुविमत्ता) और एमएल

संस्थान, मद्रास क े  साथ सहयोग से, त्रुकट धनिारण तथा डेटा और मेटाडेटा धनष्कषाण हेतु एआई 
एिं एमएल उपकरणों क े  प्रोटोटाइप का भी परीक्षण कर रहा है। इस एआई/एमएल आिाररत 
उपकरण को ई -फाइधलंग मॉ ड्यूल और िाि प्रबंिन सॉफ्टिेयर, अथाात् 'एकीकृत प्रबंिन एिं 
सूचना प्रणाली' (ICMIS) क े  साथ एकीकृत करने की पररकल्पना की गई है। कृवत्रम बुविमत्ता 
आिाररत विधिक अनुसंिान सहायक उपकरण , SUPACE (सुप्रीम कोटा पोटाल फॉर अधसस्टेंस इन 
कोटा एकफधशएंसी) , का विकास कृवत्रम बुविमत्ता सधमधत द्वारा ककया िा रहा है। इसका उद्देश्य 
िािों क े  तथ्यात्मक स्िरूप को समझना तथा पूिािती धनणायों की बुविमत्तापूणा खोि क े  माध्यम 
से िािों  का विश्लेषण करना है।

अनुसंिान विश्लेषण सहायक”(LegRAA) है, को राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान क ें द्र (NIC) की कृवत्रम 
बुविमत्ता प्रभाग तथा पुणे जस्थत सेंटर ऑफ एक्सीलेंस (ई न्यायालय), राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान 
क ें द्र की टीम द्वारा, उच्चतम न्यायालय  की ई-सधमधत क े  मागािशान में विकधसत ककया गया है। 
यह उपकरण न्यायािीशों को विधिक अनुसंिान , िस्तािेज़ विश्लेषण एिं न्याधयक धनणाय समथान 
में सहायता प्रिान करने हेतु अधभकजल्पत ककया गया है।  इसक े  अधतररक्त, “कडजिटल न्यायालय  
2.1” मंच को पररयोिना क े  तृतीय चरण क े  अंतगात विकधसत ककया गया है , जिसका उद्देश्य

क े  माध्यम से िाि आिाररत अधभिचनों, आरोप-पत्र, िस्तािेज़ आकि िेखने की सुवििा प्रिान 
करता है।  “कडजिटल न्यायालय 2.1” में िॉइस-टू-टेक्स्ट सुवििा [स्ितः भाषण पहचान एिं राष्ट्रीय

है, िो अंग्रेज़ी एिं अन्य स्थानीय भाषाओं में बोले गए आिेशों और न्यायालय में हुई क ायािाही 
का श्रुतलेखन एिं अनुिाि करने हेतु सक्षम है। “विधिक अनुसंिान विश्लेषण सहायक”(LegRAA) 
तथा “कडजिटल न्यायालय 2.1”, िोनों उपकरण , डेटा गोपनीयता एिं नैधतक सुरक्षा क े  विषयों का 
संिेिनशीलता से ध्यान रखते हैं और क े िल न्यायालय  क े  अपने आाँकड़ों, िैसे कक उच्चतम 
न्यायालय, उच्च न्यायालयों तथा जिला न्यायालयों द्वारा धनणायों और पाररत आिेशों का ही

घरेलू पययटकों स े राजस्व 
 
2214 श्री येरयम वेंकट स ुब्बा रेड्ीीः 
क्र्ा पययटन मंत्री र्ह बत ाने क ी क ृपा क रेंगे कक िः 
(क)  क्र्ा र्ह सच है कक भारत का 95 प्रतत शत  पर्यटन राजस्व  घरेल ू पर्यटक ों से आत ा है; 
(ि)  र्दि हााँ, तो मंत्रालर् 2047 तक 3 दिललर्न अमेररकी डॉलर की पर्यटन अर्यव्र्वस्र्ा 
कैसे प्राप्त कर सकता है ; 
(ग)  क्र्ा र्ह भी सच है कक पर्यटन क्षेत्र में स्वच्छता, स्व ास््र् और पर्यटक  सुरक्षा प्रमुि  
चचंता के ववषर् हैं ; और 
(घ)  र्दि हााँ, तो वविेशी पर्यटकों की संख्र्ा बढाने के ललए सरकार द्वारा क्र्ा ववशेष 
प्रर्ास ककए गए हैं? 
 
उत्तर 
पययटन मंत्री      (श्री गजेन्द्र ससंह शेखावत) 
 
(क) से (घ): राष्ट्िीर् लेिा सांख्ख्र्की 2025 के अनंतत म अनुमानों के अनुसार, पर्यटन क्षेत्र ने 
वषय  2023-24 में भारत  के सक ल  घरेल ू उत्पाि में ₹15.73 लाि करोड़ का र्ोगिान  दिर्ा, 
जो कक  कुल  अर्यव्र्व स्र्ा क ा 5.22% है। 
 
पर्यटन मंत्रालर् ने पर्यटन संबंधी अर्यव्र्वस्र्ा को बढावा िेने और िेश में वविेशी 
पर्यटकों की आमि बढाने के ललए कई पहलें  की हैं।  इनमें शालमल हैं:  
 
•  पर्यटन मंत्रालर् 'स्विेश िशयन', '  राष्ट्िीर् तीर्यर्ात्रा कार्ाकल्प और आध्र्ाख्त्मक 
ववरासत संवधयन अलभर्ान संबंधी लमशन (प्रशाि)' और 'पर्यटन अवसंरचना ववकास के  
ललए क ें द्रीर् एजेंलसर्ों को सहार्ता' जैसी र्ोजनाओं के अंतगयत िेश के ववलभन्न पर्यटन 
स्र्ल ों पर पर्यटन संबंधी अव संरच ना और सुवव धाओं के वव क ास के लल ए राज्र् 
सरकारों/ संघ राज्र्क्षेत्रों/क ें द्रीर् एजेंलसर्ों को ववत्तीर् सहार्ता प्रिान करता है। 
895                                                      

 
•  पर्यटन मंत्रालर् अपने ववलभन्न अलभर्ानों और कार्यकमों के माध्र्म से घरेल ू और 
अंतरायष्ट्िीर् बाजारों में भारत के ववलभ न्न पर्यटन स्र्लों और उत्पािों का संवधयन करता 
है। इनमें से कुछ पहल ें हैं 'िेिो अपना िेश ' अलभर्ान, ' चलो इंडडर्ा ' अलभर्ान, 
अंतरायष्ट्िीर् पर्यटन माटय और भारत पवय।  
 
•  'सेवा प्रिाताओं के ललए क्षमता तनमायण ', ' अत ुल्र् भारत  पर्यटक  सुवव धाप्रिाता' 
(आईआईटीएफ), 'पर्यटन लमत्र' और 'पर्यटन िीिी' जैसी क्षमता तनमायण और कौशल 
वव क ास पर कें दद्रत  पहल ों के माध्र्म से समग्र गुणव त्ता और आगंत ुक  अनुभव  क ो 
बेहतर बनाना।  
 
•  अन्र् ववलशष्ट्ट ववषर्ों के सार्-सार् तनरोगता पर्यटन, पाक -कला पर्यटन , ग्रामीण, 
इको -पर्यटन आदि जैसे ववषर्गत पर्यटन को  बढावा दिर्ा जाता है ताकक अन्र् क्षेत्रों में 
भी पर्यटन के िार्रे को बढार्ा जा सके।  
 
•  पर्यटन स्र्ल ों और उनके आसपास स्व च्छत ा के महत्व  क ो ध्र्ान में रि त े हुए, 
पर्यटन मंत्रालर् ने जल शख्क्त मंत्रालर् के अंतगयत पेर्जल एवं स्वच्छता ववभाग के 
सहर्ोग से स्वच्छता कार्य र्ोजना (एसएपी) तैर्ार की है। इस र्ोजना के अंतगयत , 
मंत्रालर् िेश भर में आईआईटीटीएम , क ें द्रीर् आईएचएम, राज्र् आईएचएम और 
एफसीआई जैसे संस्र्ानों के माध्र्म से स्वच्छता जागरूकता कार्यक्रमों का आर्ोजन 
करता है  ख्जसमें प्रतीकात्मक अलभर्ान और प्लाख्स्टक के उपर्ोग के ववरुद्ध अलभर्ान 
शालमल हैं । इन पहलों का उद्िेश्र् पर्यटकों , छात्रों और पर्यटन दहतधारकों के बीच 
जागरूकता पैिा करना है।  
 
•  र्द्र्वप पर्यटक ों क ी सुरक्षा मुख्र् रूप से राज्र् सरकार का ववषर् है , पर्यटन मंत्रालर् 
ने समवपयत  पर्यटन पुलल स क ी स्र्ापना के लल ए सभी राज्र् सरक ारों/ संघ राज्र्क्षेत्रों के 
प्रशासनों के समक्ष इस मामले को उठार्ा है। पर्यटन मंत्रालर् के प्रर्ासों से, तेलंगाना , 
आंध्र प्रिेश, दिल्ली, गोवा , कनायटक , केरल , महाराष्ट्ि, दहमाचल प्रिेश, जम्मू और 
कश्मीर, मध्र् प्रिेश, ओडडशा, पंजाब, राजस्र्ान, लसख्क्कम और उत्तर प्रिेश की राज्र् 
सरकारों/ संघ राज्र्क्षेत्र प्रशासनों ने कक सी न कक सी रू प में पर्यटक  पुलल स त ैनात  क ी 
है।
